body: Define B_p(E)=PV integral_0^2 omega^2*(1+p*cos(tau*omega))/(omega-E)domega. Set t_p=-1-Bp_prime(E0), d_p=-2*t_p/Bp_second(E0), Omega=E0+d, r=t*d^2, epsilon=E0+Bp(E0)+r/d. Positive enclosures put both poles above1.548 and cancel q,q_prime,q_second exactly. A nonsingular double-integral identity bounds |Bp_third|<415.359. Exact passive-pole remainder plus the bath cubic remainder give |q|, then2|q|/a_min and2*a_max/(1800-|q|) bound the two errors. Both photon directions and all supported wavepackets/reference entanglement are retained. Original checker replay exactly matches acquired JSON; independently compared rational endpoints prove the stated outward-rounded thresholds. The JSON float pairs are display values, not rigorous outward enclosures. General continuous nonconstant reciprocal dispersion preserves the parity representation, but the old numerical band does not transfer without recalibration and a new certificate.
